{"claims":[{"claim_text":"The United States will maintain its Article 5 collective security commitments to NATO.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The United States will continue to leverage America's comparative advantage in high-end military capabilities to ensure the defense of its allies.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The President is moving forward with a “phased adaptive approach” to European ballistic-missile defense that will protect both Europe and the United States from missile threats emanating from Iran and elsewhere.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The United States believes that the United States and Russia can cooperate on missile defense.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The United States will move forward with its missile defense system, beginning with the steps taken to deploy it in Poland, Turkey, and Romania.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The United States has been, and always will be, a Pacific power.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"America's future security and prosperity will be fundamentally interconnected with Asia given its status as the fastest growing economic region, with most of the world's nuclear powers and about half of the world's population.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The President has made a deliberate and strategic decision that the United States will play a larger and long-term role in shaping the Asia-Pacific region and its future.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
